items.title: Millimeter-Wave Network Clusters For Autonomous Digital Infrastructure
items.summary: Peraso Inc. and Virewirx, Inc. collaborated to develop and demonstrate a millimeter-wave wireless network cluster capable of achieving a 50Gbps peak aggregate data capacity. This integration of specialized semiconductor hardware and network control software targets autonomous systems, such as drone swarms and automated industrial vehicles, operating in congested spatial environments.

items.title: Peraso (PRSO) and Virewirx Achieve Milestone in Drone Communication Technology
items.summary: Peraso Inc PRSO and Virewirx announced a successful demonstration of a simulated environment for drone wireless communication, achieving a peak data capacity exceeding 50Gbps. This milestone underscores the collaborative efforts of both companies, with Peraso contributing its innovative 60 GHz wireless semiconductor solutions and Virewirx providing its VX60 High-Performance Wireless Network.
